messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT 2026-03-17T18:34Z - high error rate observed on embeddings-proxy in eu-west-1 (auto-page)
alex: ack. I'm primary for the evening. seeing 502s from embed-worker pods, p95 latency ~1.2s -> 6s. Fallbacks are tripping for some customers. :warning:
tara: any obvious root cause yet? perf regression from recent model roll?
alex: looks like a KV-cache thrash after the quant rollout earlier today. memory pressure + eviction churn on a subset of pods. we've already migrated traffic off 3 unhealthy nodes to reduce noise.
sam: tagging runbook: https://wiki.redwood/internal/runbooks/embeddings-eviction
sam: quick check list from runbook:
```
1) scale down quant-model variant
2) re-route eu-west traffic to fallback model: embeddings-v1-safe
3) increase KV cache size on affected fleet
4) restart pods with corrupted caches
```

mike: customer-impact: support reports ~4 accounts with timeouts and degraded similarity results. CS notified, low severity for now but could escalate if p95 > 10s.
alex: taking steps 1+2 now. running:
```
# scale rollback
kubectl -n inference scale deploy quant-model-v2 --replicas=0
# route rule
redwoodctl traffic set --service embeddings --region eu-west-1 --variant embeddings-v1-safe
```
oncall-bot: deploy-bot: traffic change applied by alex at 2026-03-17T18:39Z
alex: observed p95 drop to ~1.1s after reroute. errors reduced to baseline. still seeing occasional evictions on older nodes. :thumbsup:
tara: logging shows continued cache eviction spikes on node eu-west-1b. suggest a rolling restart for that AZ tonight; risky but will reduce churn.
sam: I'll open a ticket for infra to check node kernel oom settings and nvme GC timing: https://issues.redwood/INFRA-1429
mike: next steps for customer comms? we told CS to keep affected accounts informed; no formal incident page required yet, but monitor for 1 hour.
alex: handoff plan: I'll remain primary until 23:00 UTC, tara will be secondary until 02:00 UTC. coverage gap note: APAC overnight doesn't have a designated secondary — @sam can you cover APAC watch until we roster a proper secondary? :pray:
sam: I can watch APAC for tonight, will respond to pages and relay to infra if needed.
alex: checklist for night shift (short):
- monitor eu-west embed error rate + p95 (grafana link)
- watch eviction metric: embed_cache_evictions/sec
- infra ticket INFRA-1429 owner: sam
- follow-up: investigate quant rollout canary thresholds and adjust

tara: adding runbook bookmark and quick play: https://wiki.redwood/internal/runbooks/embeddings-eviction#mitigation
mike: filing a post-incident note draft in /incidents/2026-03-17-embed-eviction if things remain stable.
alex: status: mitigated, partial rollback done, customer impact limited and improving. owners: alex (primary), tara (secondary), sam (infra follow-up). will update this thread before handoff at 22:50 UTC. :white_check_mark:
